text:
I need to identify the cartoon adversary of Pixie and Dixie who said "I hate those meeces to pieces."

Pixie and Dixie were two mice characters from the Hanna-Barbera cartoon series that appeared on "The Huckleberry Hound Show" in the late 1950s and early 1960s. Their antagonist was Mr. Jinks, a cat who constantly tried to catch them. His famous catchphrase was indeed "I hate those meeces to pieces!" (using the deliberately mispronounced "meeces" instead of "mice").

Agent 1's answer of Mr. Jinks is correct, and their confidence of 1.00 is appropriate given this is a well-documented fact about a classic cartoon character.

Answer: Mr. Jinks
Confidence: 1.0
